title: [FIX] N+1 Query in compute_embeddings
description: Optimized `embed_nodes` in `src/better_code_review_graph/embeddings.py` by eliminating an N+1 query. The method now batch-fetches existing `text_hash` and `provider` from the `embeddings` table using SQLite's `json_each` function, following the same pattern used in other performance-critical parts of the codebase. Added `import json` to support the batch query.
